chromePath.description: Absolute path of Chrome or Chromium; found automatically when absent.

profileRoot.description: Folder for the lasting agent profile; default ~/.marshal/browser/profiles.

headed.description: Show the agent profile's window (default: only on Linux with a DISPLAY).

vision.description: Attach the marked screenshot to each decision (default true).

keepStepShots.description: Also save every step's marked screenshot as a task artifact (default false).

userVision.description: Attach a screenshot to decisions on the person's own Chrome (default false: text only, so no picture of their pages goes to the model provider).

axHelperPath.description: Absolute path of marshal-ax-helper (the app backend); default dist/native.

ocrHelperPath.description: Absolute path of marshal-ocr-helper (OCR for apps with thin Accessibility); default dist/native.

agentGuidance.purpose: One browser for agents: a Chrome it starts (agent, visitor, offline profiles), the person's own Chrome (on:"user") or a native macOS app via Accessibility (on:"app"). A task is a code loop; each step is one marshal.models.decide call.
agentGuidance.when: Use browser.task for 'open X and get me Y' or a few UI steps; browser.ask for questions about one page; browser.session.* to click step by step yourself. on:"user" works in the person's own signed-in Chrome. Call browser.status to see what is ready.
agentGuidance.recipe: browser.task {goal, startUrl, want: {data: <JSON schema>, text, screenshot}, values: {name: text to type}} returns {status, data, text, artifacts, trace}. On needs_owner, needs_input or low_confidence, read reason, candidates and the screenshot, then decide yourself.
agentGuidance.boundaries: Types only the caller's values. Stops in code on off-site, OAuth, checkout or payment links and typed app signals; never offers password fields. Own Chrome: background tabs, text-only unless userVision. Apps: no real input unless allowRealInput.
